edits.expected: Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
edits.replacement: Yea, I think it right, as long as I am in this tent that is my body, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance;
edits.reason: The body is a temporary tent, not the Jerusalem sanctuary. An explicit relative avoids interrupting the sentence with competing appositive commas; right/remembering prior repair preserved.

edits.replacement: Knowing that shortly I must put off this tent of mine, even as our Lord Jesus Christ hath showed me.
edits.reason: Continues body/tent image already explicit in13, preserving imminent laying aside and showed previous spelling.

edits.expected: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.
edits.reason: The complete verse preserves earlier approved edits and the newly reviewed contextual clarifications.
edits.replacement: For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit.

edits.expected: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privily shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
edits.replacement: But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who shall secretly bring in destructive heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction.
edits.reason: Privily means secretly, not just in a private setting. Heresies bring destruction; Lord who bought them is explicitly retained, not explained away for doctrinal convenience.

edits.expected: And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
edits.replacement: And through greed shall they with fabricated words profit at your expense: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.
edits.reason: Exploit hearers for gain with false speech, not a consensual sale of products. Greed previous repair and judgment/slumber image remain.
